Thank you for coming. I hope I'm not keeping you from your work.
It's all right. I think I know a little of what you want to discuss...
Do you? Then you already know. That expression of someone who has lost memories...
strings.(기억을 잃은 표정 때문에 샤이닉에게 도움을 받았다고 전한다.): (You explain that Shynic helped you with your lost memories.)
strings.그 아이가 투덜대긴 해도 자신의 사람이라 여긴 자에겐 모든 걸 내어준다네: She may grumble, but she gives everything to those she considers her own.
Indeed. Don't doubt it. I was going to mention the Tears of Light, too. Brew them into a drink, and there are almost no side effects.
Oh! You're not supposed to just swallow them?
strings.그걸 삼켰는가? 그 독한 걸…?: You swallowed them? Those potent things...?
strings.전에 내가 그분을 위해 준 것을 기억하는가?: Do you remember what I gave you for her before?
strings.그래, 그때의 '기억의 파편'은 온전히 그분을 위한 것이었지만, 이번에: Yes. Those fragments were entirely for her. But what I'm discussing now may serve your own memories.
Lord Atkina, I haven't lost any memories from the Land of Illusions...
strings.빛의 눈물과 같은 역할을 한다고 생각하게. 설마, 이번에도 위험한 걸 먹: Think of them as serving the same purpose as the Tears of Light. Surely you don't think I'll make you eat something dangerous again?
strings.내가 힘으로 만들어 전달할 테니 너무 겁먹지 말게나. 용의 계곡에 있는: I'll turn them into energy and pass it to you, so don't be afraid. Gather a suitable amount from the mythical beasts in Dragon Valley.
Then I'll purify them and infuse you with their energy.
strings.감사합니다. 아드키나 님! 그럼 다녀오겠습니다!: Thank you, Lord Atkina! I'll be back!
Well done. I'll begin the purification.
strings.오래 걸리는 작업은 아닐세. 부족한 실력이나마 그대에게 도움이 됐으면 좋: It isn't a lengthy process. I hope my modest skill has helped you.
strings.이미 그 기운은 그대에게로 향했으니 어떤 계기만 있으면 금방 기억이 돌아: The energy has already entered you. With a suitable trigger, your memories should soon return.
Thank you, Lord Atkina! Oh, you seem to have something else to say.
strings.그대는 눈치가 빠르군. 그대가 들어줬으면 하는 이야기가 있네. 혹시 그대: Perceptive. There's something I'd like you to hear. Do you know Xenadia?
strings.네. 그곳에 다녀온 적도 있는데…. 그곳에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 기억이: Yes. I've visited... But I can't really remember what happened there.
strings.아마 그대는 제나디아와 관련된 기억을 잃어버린 듯하네. 내가 왜 제나디아: It seems you've lost memories connected to Xenadia. The reason I mention it is...
It's my homeland. Every Pluton dragon was born there.
strings.그대가 나와 개인적으로 대화를 해서 이미 알고 있겠지만, 난 과거 세레스: As you know from our private conversations, I once joined Goddess Seres in the battle against the Demon King.
strings.비록 뜻대로 되지 않아 이곳에 떨어져 오랫동안 고향으로 돌아갈 수 없었지: Things did not go as hoped. I fell here and couldn't return home for a very long time. Then I learned the Demon King had vanished through Goddess Iris's efforts.
And that the wall separating Freios and Jiendia had disappeared.
I have a duty to protect this land, given by Goddess Gaia... Even with her permission, I cannot leave my post.
There's no one to replace me. Perhaps I need to train a successor.
strings.하하하, 농담도 잘하는군. 그대가 자리를 비울 수 없는 나를 위해, 그리: Hahaha! A fine joke. Visit Xenadia for me, who cannot leave, and for yourself as well.
strings.그대 무슨 생각을 그리하는가?: What has you thinking so deeply?
strings.아, 아니에요. 그러면 제나디아에 다녀올게요. 어떤 일을 하면 되죠?: Oh, nothing. I'll go to Xenadia. What should I do?
strings.어려운 일은 아니네. 제나디아에 가서 신관과 시스터들에게 내 안부를 전해: Nothing difficult. Give my regards to the priests and Sisters. They'll know what to tell you.
Mir has often carried my messages. This time, please do it yourself.
I will. Mir is busy enough. I'll make the trip.
strings.아직도 오르카 해변 안쪽에 제나디아로 갈 수 있는 석탑이 있는가?: Is there still a stone tower leading to Xenadia deep within Orca Beach?
Yes. You can reach it that way.
strings.그러면 그곳에 도착해 세레스 여신님을 위해 기도해주게. 그게 내 부탁이야: Then offer a prayer to Goddess Seres when you arrive. That's all I ask. Once you're finished, return to your own duties.
This place is as mysterious as ever.
strings.(석탑 앞에서 고개를 숙인 채 조용히 기도를 한다. 언제나 그렇듯이 이: (You bow before the stone tower and pray quietly, wishing, as always, for this world and Iris to remain safe.)
strings.(갑자기 이상한 느낌이 든다.): (A strange feeling suddenly comes over you.)
strings.(석탑 앞에 희미하게 누군가의 잔영이 보인다. 청초한 모습에 화관을 쓴: (A faint afterimage appears before the tower. A delicate girl wearing a flower crown has a sacred air about her.)
strings.뭐지? 환영인가? 누구지?: What is this? An illusion? Who is she?
strings.(잔영으로 보이는 소녀가 살며시 미소를 보인다.): (The girl in the afterimage smiles softly.)
strings.누구지? 설마 세레스 여신?: Who...? Could it be Goddess Seres?
strings.(갑자기 머릿속에서 세레스라는 이름이 떠오른다.): (The name Seres suddenly comes to mind.)
strings.맞아, 내가 세레스 여신님을 못 알아볼리가 없잖아. 그럼 이건 누구…?: Of course. I couldn't fail to recognize Goddess Seres. Then who is this...?
strings.(%s의 혼잣말에 소녀가 슬픈 미소를 보인다. 그리고 뭐라고 말을 하기: (At %s's murmuring, the girl smiles sadly and begins to speak. No voice can be heard.)
strings.뭐라고 하는데, 들리지가 않아. 잠깐, 천천히 말해주겠어? 입모양이라도: She's saying something, but I can't hear. Wait. Could you speak slowly, so I can read your lips?
strings.(소녀가 고개를 끄덕인다. 그리고 %s의 부탁대로 천천히 입을 연다.): (The girl nods and slowly opens her mouth, as %s asks.)
strings.마.침.내… 이. 날.이 왔.어…. 나.는 너.를… 아.주 오.랫.동.안: At... last... this... day... has... come... I... have... waited... for... you... for... so... long...
strings.잠깐 이 말은…? 이 기시감은?: Wait, those words...? Why this sense of déjà vu?
strings.세레스 여신님? 정말 세레스 여신님이세요? 여신님의 힘은 이미 이리스에게: Goddess Seres? Is it really you? I thought all your power had already passed to Iris...
strings.(소녀가 웃는 얼굴로 힘겹게 다음 할 말을 이어간다.): (Still smiling, the girl struggles to continue.)
strings.안.녕…. 기.다.렸.어. 여.기.까.지. 오.느.라. 힘.들.었.지?: Hello... I've... been... waiting... Was... the... journey... here... difficult? You're asking if it was hard?
No, it wasn't. Coming all this way, I...
strings.(갑자기 %s의 머릿속에 여러 가지 기억들이 떠오르기 시작한다. 실체를: (Suddenly, many memories begin to rise in %s's mind, along with subtle feelings whose source cannot be grasped.)
strings.(소녀가 슬픈 표정으로 손을 뻗어 %s의 머리를 쓰다듬으려 한다.): (With a sorrowful expression, the girl reaches out to stroke %s's head.)
strings.(소녀가 살며시 고개를 끄덕인다. 그리고 입을 벌려 뭔가 다시 이야기를: (The girl nods softly, then opens her mouth to speak again.)
My... name... is... Seres... In... the... age... when... the... first... stars... fell... on... Orca... Beach... I... sowed... the... seeds... of... life... and... song... across... the... world...
strings.기.억.을. 잃.게.해.서. 미.안.해? 자, 잠깐…. 내가 기억을 잃어: I'm... sorry... for... making... you... lose... your... memories? Wait... You're the reason I lost them?
strings.(자신을 세레스라고 밝힌 소녀의 모습이 점점 희미해져 보이지 않는다. ): (The girl who named herself Seres grows fainter until she can no longer be seen.)
She seemed to be trying to say something before disappearing...
My head is a mess. Has something happened to me, too...? Why did I lose my memories...?
strings.이리스, 듣고 있으면 이야기해줄래?: Iris, if you can hear me, will you tell me?
strings.역시 답이 없네. 어쩔 수 없지. 일단 나중에 이야기하기로 하고…. 여기: No answer again. It can't be helped. We can talk later... I came here for Lord Atkina's request first...
strings.일단 전에 만났던 신관에게 가봐야겠어. 지금 내가 기억하고 있는 제나디아: I'll go to the priest I met before. He's the only priest in Xenadia I remember now.
strings.자네, 제나디아에 얼마 전에 오지 않았는가? 혹시, 무슨 일이 있는건가: Weren't you here in Xenadia recently? Has something happened?
Lost your memories again, perhaps...? Ah, you seem normal.
Sorry for the late greeting. I had something on my mind. I haven't lost my memories.
strings.오늘은 무슨 일이지? 저번처럼 미르가 먹을 감자랑 고구마를 캐러왔어?: What brings you here today? More potatoes and sweet potatoes for Mir, like last time?
strings.그건 아니고, 아드키나 님의 부탁으로 왔습니다. 안부를 전해달라고 하셔서: No. Lord Atkina sent me to give you his regards...
strings.선배님은 잘 계시는군. 그런데 자네는 선배님을 어떻게 알고 있는가?: So my senior is well. How do you know him?
strings.(환영의 대지, 아드리카에서 있었던 일을 신관 크라토스에게 이야기한다.): (You tell Priest Kratos what happened in Adrica, in the Land of Illusions.)
strings.아, 가이아 여신님께서 깨어나셨나 보군. 벌써 그런 시기가 됐다니…. 내: Ah, Goddess Gaia has awakened. Has that time come already...? I thought I'd never hear that news in my lifetime.
strings.그런데 선배님 이야기를 하면 신관과 시스터들이 알아서 뭘 할 거라고? 나: He said the priests and Sisters would know what to do if you mentioned him? I haven't heard anything...
Wait. The Sisters? He must be mistaken.
strings.미르가 자주 다녀가긴 하지만, 프레이오스에서 있었던 일은 이야기하지 않아: Mir visits often, but doesn't discuss events in Freios. He probably doesn't know.
Then who's the Sister here...? Sister Sistina is here...
strings.현재 제나디아엔 시스터들이 한 명도 안 계시네. 무슨 소리를 하는지 모르: There are no Sisters in Xenadia now. I don't know what you're talking about.
strings.시스터들께선 신탁을 받아 프레이오스에 있는 신전에 가셨다가 행방불명되셨네: They received a revelation and went to the temple in Freios, then disappeared.
strings.마계 군주 럭스가 신전을 습격하던 중에 그곳에 있던 아이들을 구출하시면서: We lost contact when Lux, lord of the Demon Realm, attacked the temple and they rescued the children there.
Come to think of it, you...
strings.그런 것이었군. 이제 이해했어. 넌 단순히 기억을 잃은 게 아니었어. 시: So that's it. Now I understand. You haven't simply lost memories. You're standing at a distorted boundary of time and space, perhaps.
strings.아, 혹시 이곳에 와서 또 다른 걸 보거나 느끼진 않았어?: Did you see or feel anything else when you came here?
I saw an afterimage of Lady Seres at the statue on Orca Beach.
strings.저번에 이야기했다시피 제나디아는 시간의 흐름과 공간의 인식이 다른 장소와: As I said last time, time flows differently in Xenadia, as does the perception of space.
strings.아마도 네 앞에 여신님의 잔영이 나타난 건 뭔가 알려주시기 위한 건 아닐: Perhaps her afterimage appeared to tell you something? At least, she is certainly worried...
strings.제가 왜 제나디아에서만 이런 현상을 겪어야 하는 거죠? 이러다 무슨 큰일: Why does this only happen to me in Xenadia? It won't lead to something terrible, will it?
I don't know. That's as much help as I can offer.
strings.후우. 그럼 묵상의 방에 있는 시무르그에게 가서 아드키나 님의 이야기만: Sigh. Go to Simurgh in the Chamber of Meditation and speak only of Lord Atkina. He'll tell you what to do for him.
I'm sorry. But I'm sure you'll discover the cause soon.
strings.필멸자여, 어서 오시게. 특별한 별이 이곳으로 오고 있는 느낌을 받았는데: Welcome, mortal. I felt a special star approaching, and here you are.
I've come from Adrica in Eastland to deliver Lord Atkina's regards.
strings.(환영의 대지, 아드리카에서 있었던 일을 신관 시무르그에게 이야기한다.): (You tell Priest Simurgh what happened in Adrica, in the Land of Illusions.)
strings.가이아 여신님께서 깨어나셨군. 많은 일이 일어나서 정신없는데도 이곳까지: Goddess Gaia has awakened. Thank you for coming all this way amid so many events.
When you next see my senior, please tell him we're well.
strings.아, 내 정신을 보게. 선배님께 드리려고 했던 물건이 있었는데…. 원래는: Ah, where's my head? There was something I intended to send him... Mir was going to take it.
But the child suddenly had work for Lady Iris, so it was delayed...
strings.제나디아에서만 자라는 식물을 아드리카에도 자라게 하고 싶어 하셔서 잔뜩: He wanted plants found only in Xenadia to grow in Adrica, too. I gathered plenty...
I gathered them, then forgot where I put them.
I understand. You'd like me to find them.
Who has time to search? Gathering fresh ones would be faster.
strings.정화의 풀과 달무리 풀을 뽑아서 아드키나 님에게 가져다주시게. 그 풀이: Pick some Purification Grass and Moon Halo Grass and take them to Lord Atkina. They'll help cleanse the pollution where he lives.
strings.지상정원 중앙 지역에 고이 몸을 숨기고 있지. 필멸자인 자네에게는 잘 보: Tucked away in the central area of the Aboveground Garden. A mortal like you will spot them easily. Gather plenty for my senior.
And I hope you recover your lost memories.
strings.제나디아에서 바로 다른 볼일을 보러 갈 줄 알았더니 용의 계곡엔 무슨 일: I thought you'd go straight from Xenadia to other business. What brings you back to Dragon Valley?
The priests asked me to bring these plants.
strings.(아드키나에게 채집한 정화의 풀과 달무리 풀을 건넨다.): (You give Atkina the Purification Grass and Moon Halo Grass you gathered.)
It's been so long. The scent of my homeland, Xenadia...
strings.(아드키나가 잠시 감상에 빠진 듯 말을 이어가지 못한다.): (Atkina falls silent for a moment, lost in reflection.)
strings.원래는 미르가 가져다 주려고 했다더군요. 그런데 갑자기 이리스의 일을 하: Mir was supposed to bring them, but suddenly had work for Iris, so it seems the delivery was delayed...
strings.아아, 그 아이가…. 마음이 예쁜 아이지. 나중에 감사를 표해야겠네. 물: Ah, that child... Such a kind heart. I'll have to give my thanks. With food, of course.
strings.(아드키나의 얼굴에 짙은 그림자가 드리운다. 아무래도 먹을 걸 준비하는: (A shadow crosses Atkina's face. Preparing enough food seems daunting. A moment later, his expression returns to normal.)
strings.이 식물들을 키울 생각을 하니 기분이 좋아지는군. 신성한 땅에서 자란 이: The thought of growing these plants cheers me. Raised in sacred soil, they'll help reduce this land's pollution.
Goddess Gaia will be pleased, too.
I owe you again. How can I repay you...?
strings.그런데 그대 표정을 보아하니 제나디아에서 무슨 일이 있었나 보군. 무슨: But your expression suggests something happened in Xenadia. What was it?
strings.(아드키나에게 오르카 해변에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (You tell Atkina what happened on Orca Beach.)
strings.그대, 뭐라고 했나? 세레스 여신님의 잔영을 봤다고?: What did you say? You saw Goddess Seres's afterimage?
strings.세레스 여신님은 남아있는 힘을 모두 이리스 님께 전달하셨네. 이리스 여신: She passed all her remaining power to Lady Iris. Unless Goddess Iris wills it, Seres cannot appear in any form.
Yet if she appeared before you as an afterimage, there must be a definite reason.
strings.아무래도 그 이유가 그대의 '기억'과 이어지는 것 같군. 하여튼, 그대의: That reason seems connected to your memories. In any case, I'm glad your expression looks better.
strings.이리스 여신님께서 온전한 성계신이 된다면야 모두 해결되는 일일세. 지금은: Once Iris becomes a complete God of the Astral Realm, it will all be resolved. For now, she continues working toward it...
Then I'll wait. Perhaps an answer will turn up somewhere.
strings.그럼 가볼게요, 아드키나 님. 그리고 환영의 대지가 좀 더 아름다워지길: I'll be going, Lord Atkina. May the Land of Illusions grow even more beautiful.
strings.고맙네. 가이아 여신님께서 보시기에 만족스러우실 그런 땅을 만들도록 하지: Thank you. I'll make it a land Goddess Gaia can look upon with satisfaction.
strings.벌써 이 험한 용의 계곡을 쉽게 쉽게 빠져나가는 걸 보면 역시 대단한 인: Already moving so easily through this dangerous valley... Truly remarkable.
Goddess Iris, you seem to be hiding something from that adventurer. What could it be...?
